I don't have `reference/experimental/flowchart.md` loaded in this conversation (only the router file above), so I can't guarantee every keyword spelling below is exact — I'm composing it from the router's stated pattern (node-type keywords, quoted labels, `->` edges, and the general `class`/`title`/`figdown` rules that hold across genres). Please run `node <skill-dir>/build-svg.js changerequest.fd` and fix any line-numbered errors it reports; I flag this because per the doc's own rule, an unverified construct should be stated rather than presented as certain.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 flowchart
title "Change request procedure"

process receive "Receive change request"
process validate "Validate against policy"
decision isvalid "Valid?"
process apply "Apply change to device"
terminator confirm "Confirm success"
terminator rollback "Roll back"

group changewindow "Change window" {
  validate
  apply
}

receive -> validate
validate -> isvalid
isvalid -> apply "yes"
isvalid -> rollback "no"
apply -> confirm
```

The host Markdown embed (once the SVG is built) should be:

```markdown
![Change request procedure flowchart](figures/changerequest.svg)

<sub>source: [figures/changerequest.fd](figures/changerequest.fd)</sub>
```

Note: the `.fd` source itself must never contain that Markdown wrapper — that was the bug in the previous attempt (the embed snippet was saved as `changerequest.fd` instead of the actual FigDown source), which is exactly what the validator's three errors point at.
